desc: Define a sorted representation `(left, right, weight, original_index)` ordered by left endpoint.
Precompute `next[i]` with `bisect_right(starts, end_i)` to enforce strictly non-overlapping intervals.
Build bottom-up DP for each position and capacity `0..4`, comparing skip versus take transitions.
Store selected original indices as sorted tuples/lists and implement score-first, lexicographic-second comparison.
Extract and return the DP result starting at interval `0` with capacity `4`.
